title.ko: 면접 질문과 대답: 현재완료 · 과거 경험 · would like to
title.en: job interviews: present perfect, past experience, would like to

explain.ko: 면접에서는 경력과 경험을 말할 때 현재완료(I've worked in sales for three years)와 과거형(I was responsible for training new staff)을 구분해 씁니다. 지금까지 이어지는 경력은 현재완료 + for / since, 이미 끝난 일은 과거형입니다. 동기는 I'd like to ...(~하고 싶어요), I'm interested in ...(~에 관심이 있어요)로 말합니다. 강점은 My strength is ... / I'm good at -ing로, 약점은 솔직하되 개선 노력을 함께 말하는 것이 좋습니다.
explain.en: In interviews use the present perfect for experience that continues up to now (I've worked in sales for three years) and the past simple for finished jobs (I was responsible for training new staff). Say your motivation with I'd like to ... or I'm interested in ... Talk about strengths with My strength is ... / I'm good at -ing; when you mention a weakness, add how you are improving.

notes.en: Present perfect for continuing experience; past simple for finished jobs.

notes.ko: 면접에서는 줄임말보다 완전한 문장과 정중한 표현이 좋습니다.
notes.en: Complete sentences and polite forms work best in interviews.

notes.en: After responsible for use -ing or a noun.
